evidence_note: RETROSPECTIVE, not pre-registered: built after the election with the result and market resolutions known. The v1 headline settings use the 2021 night only. The v2 sensitivity was also chosen after the 2025 result was known; archive searches found 2021 replayable, only one stamped page in 2017 and none in 2013, so its fixed multi-night rule also has only 2021 available. Neither version uses the 2025 count to select settings.
settle_gated_note: per race (its first market): gate = first minute with >= 1% of the electorate counted; model = max(model settle, gate); lead = Polymarket settle - gated model settle, minutes (settle = staying >= 0.9 on the outcome to the end of the night, 07:00 CET)

reasons.capacity: dollars of real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price in the 30 min after each frozen-rule signal (0 s latency); the trades come from Polymarket's public data API
reasons.profit: the frozen night rule run unchanged on this replay (analysis/edge_audit.py); decided-before-count markets were already priced near 0 or 1, so the rule finds few trades there
reasons.arbitrage: Kalshi lists no thin-spread pairs through the count (its 'parties in parliament' markets closed 15:00 UTC, before polls closed)
reasons.calibration: minutes from 1% to 95% counted (electorate share); the party's projected final second-vote share against the official final, 90% band from the 2021-calibrated sd
reasons.settle.kalshi: Kalshi traded only the 'most seats' and '2nd place' markets through the count, thinly (12 to 23 one-minute candles each)

accuracy.pwin_window: contested = the markets Polymarket had not settled (>= 0.9 on the outcome to the end) before the first count information; minutes from then to the last national page
accuracy.outcome: Polymarket resolution (identical to the official final, Bundeswahlleiterin 14 March 2025)

profit.rule: frozen night rule: favoured side only, edge >= 5c after costs, >= 1% of the market counted, first signal per market, held to resolution
profit.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; return at the signal's all-in cost (price + 1c half-spread + taker fee)

brier_by_counted.window: minutes from the first count information to the last national page (2025-02-23T19:38:00Z to 2025-02-24T00:33:37Z)

unavailable_nights.2017: one stamped Wahlkreis page; not replayable
unavailable_nights.2013: no result-page captures during election night

market_classification.definition: eventual outcome >= 0.90 at the first minute at/after official poll close and never below 0.80 afterwards

invest10k.execution: model limit: after the 1% gate, 10% of every real taker trade (Israel: resting ask in the recorded book) on the favoured side whose all-in price leaves the model >= 5c, using the model P known >= 60 s earlier; no per-market cap
invest10k.note: Single event: every bet depends on the same election-night count, so the markets move together and this is one outcome, not many independent bets. 78% of the eligible volume was in one market (bsw-wins-5-or-more-of-vote-in-german-election). Eligible volume is an upper bound: other traders took those trades.

signal_price.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; cost = signal price + half-spread + taker fee (retrospective replay, v1)
